# MakaLight 0.1.1 — bundled Windows studio

Fixes **blank studio window** on first install (missing `index.html` + `maka-bridge.js` in the synced bundle).

**Install:** `MakaLight-amd64-installer.exe` — includes **MakaLight.exe**, **open MAKA.relay** (`relay/`), and **node.exe** (`node/`).

**Includes:** WHIP ingest, studio UI synced from Electron renderer, WebView2 shell, no in-app browser.
